subject: House of Skulltula
text: Destroying the one hundred Gold Skulltulas around Hyrule frees the family in the House of Skulltula of its curse.

evidence.quote:
If you find and destroy the one hundred Gold
Skulltulas around Hyrule, then you will free the family of it's curse.

subject: Adult's Wallet
text: Collecting 10 Gold Skulltula tokens rewards the Adult's Wallet, which raises rupee capacity from 99 rupees to 200 rupees.

evidence.quote:
10 Tokens - Adult's Wallet

The Adult's Wallet raises your rupee capacity from 99 rupees to 200 rupees.

subject: Stone of Agony
text: Collecting 20 Gold Skulltula tokens rewards the Stone of Agony, which causes the Rumble Pak to rumble near a hidden pit.

evidence.quote:
20 Tokens - The Stone of Agony

The Stone of Agony causes your Rumble Pak to Rumble when you near a hidden pit.

subject: Giant's Wallet
text: Collecting 30 Gold Skulltula tokens rewards the Giant's Wallet, which raises rupee capacity from 200 to 500 rupees.

evidence.quote:
30 Tokens - Giant's Wallet

The Giant's Wallet raises your rupee capacity from 200 to 500 rupees.

subject: Bombchus
text: Collecting 40 Gold Skulltula tokens rewards Bombchus.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Collecting 50 Gold Skulltula tokens rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
50 Tokens - Piece of Heart

At 50, you get the best reward, a Piece of Heart.

subject: Huge Rupee
text: Collecting all 100 Gold Skulltulas rewards 200 rupees, which can be claimed repeatedly by speaking with the Patriarch again after leaving and re-entering the house.

evidence.quote:
100 Tokens - Huge Rupee

Yep.  The ultimate reward for getting all 100 Gold Skulltulas is... 200 rupees.
Sort of.  You can keep leaving and re-entering the house, speaking with the
Patriarch again to get another 200 rupees.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: During nighttime, a Gold Skulltula is found behind the Know-It-All Brothers House in Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote:
This Gold Skulltula is found behind the Know-It-All Brothers House during
nighttime.  The Know-It-All Brothers House is the building to the right as you
enter Kokiri Forest from Hyrule Field.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dropping a Bottled Bug into the patch of soft earth behind the Kokiri Shop causes a Gold Skulltula to emerge.

evidence.quote:
Drop a Bottled Bug into the Patch of Soft Earth behind the Kokiri Shop.  A Gold
Skulltula will emerge.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At the back of the Twin's House near the entrance to the Deku Tree, the Hookshot is used to find and kill a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Head for the back of the Twin's House.  This is the house with the two branches
coming out of the top.  It's next door to Saria's House, and closest to the
entrance to the Deku Tree.  Use the Hookshot to find and kill the Gold
Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dropping a Bottled Bug into the patch of soft earth in the southwest corner valley of the Lost Woods causes a Gold Skulltula to appear.

evidence.quote:
Head for the valley in the southwest corner of the Lost Woods.  Drop a Bottled
Bug into the patch of soft earth, where a Gold Skulltula will appear.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dropping a Bottled Bug into the patch of soft earth in the clearing near the Forest Stage entrance in the central Lost Woods causes a Gold Skulltula to appear.

evidence.quote:
Head for the clearing in the center of the Lost Woods, near where you enter the
Forest Stage.  Drop a Bottled Bug into the patch of soft earth, where a Gold
Skulltula will appear.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Planting a Magic Bean in the central Lost Woods clearing as Young Link allows Adult Link to ride the Magic Leaf to reach a Gold Skulltula on the ledge.

evidence.quote:
As Young Link, plant a Magic Bean in the patch of soft earth in the clearing
near the center of the Lost Woods.  Return here as Adult Link, and you will
find a Gold Skulltula on the ledge that the Magic Leaf leads to.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Climbing the ladder near the stairs in Sacred Forest Meadow and jumping along the cliff reveals a Gold Skulltula high on the east wall that can be killed with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
Climb up the ladder near the stairs in the back of the Sacred Forest Meadow.
Jump along the cliff of the maze, and look high on the east wall to see the
Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token with the Hookshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Using a bomb near the roots of the lone tree north of Kakariko Village reveals a pit containing a Gold Skulltula high on the opposite wall.

evidence.quote:
Head for the lone tree in the corner of Hyrule Field, north of Kakariko
Village.  Use a bomb near the roots of the tree to reveal a pit.  Drop down it,
and you will find a pit which contains a Gold Skulltula high on the opposite
wall.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Placing a bomb in the circle of stones east of Gerudo Valley opens a pit where Din's Fire burns webbing to reveal a Gold Skulltula on the wall behind the cow.

evidence.quote:
Look for a circle of stones east of Gerudo Valley.  Place a bomb in the middle
of the stones to reveal a pit.  Drop down it.  Use Din's Fire to burn away the
webbing covering the walls in the room, then look in the alcove which contains
the Cow.  On the wall behind the Cow is a Gold Skulltula.
